raw_result.summary: T008 discovery found that the accepted OctoberBatchSetupPolicy seam cannot express the context-provenance outcomes assigned to T008/T009. The request carries only context scope and record IDs, the trusted authority carries no context snapshots, the result exposes no context data, and the policy has no reader port. A behavioral test at this seam could only verify reference forwarding, not selection or retention of values, origin, time, applicability or disagreement.

finding.evidence: OctoberSetupRequest.ContextSelections is IReadOnlyList<OctoberContextSelection>, where OctoberContextSelection contains only Scope and RecordId. OctoberAuthorizedSelection contains target, batch, subject, canonical database identity, Repository IDs and selection digest. OctoberBatchSetupPolicy owns only IOctoberSetupWriter. Existing GlobalContext, System and Repository records contain context values and timestamps, but none are available at the policy seam. The retained test owner stopped without editing or manufacturing RED.
finding.required_outcome: Define one trusted, public setup-policy input for immutable selected advisory context that carries applicable scope, originating authority/record, value, selection time and explicit disagreement/nonapplicability. Keep the one Core policy and one writer, retain the server-derived subject and exact Repository/membership/digest checks, and preserve advisory text as non-source evidence. Reconcile the fixed contract and T008/T009 without introducing a second setup policy or flattening context provenance.
